verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no Orama policy, setting, or contractual commitment saying customer data is excluded from AI model training. On-prem deployment, the self-hostable open-source library, and local embedding models are adjacent data-locality features, not a documented training opt-out or no-training guarantee, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
